variants.note: Toyota 135 hp; Wikipedia 135 PS (133 hp) - same nominal figure, unit differs. Hagerty valuation snippets (not usable) show 125 hp for 1975/1978 FJ40. 2F from Aug 1975 production.

unverified.stroke_in: 4.0000 in (101.6 mm): stated only by Wikipedia among checked sources (Toyota 2F repair manual and Elgin give no stroke). Arithmetic supports it: 94 x 94 x 101.6 x 0.7854 x 6 = 4,230.5 cc vs 4,230 cc published (Toyota Global, Wikipedia); Elgin 4,227 cc. Same 101.6 mm stroke as the F (Toyota 1950 table).
unverified.firing_order: 1-5-3-6-2-4: Toyota 2F Engine Repair Manual (1980) service specifications only.
